topic.label: Stocks and Equities
topic.desc: Shares in companies: common and preferred stock, fundamental and technical analysis, corporate actions, and reading company filings.

concepts.label: Corporate Actions
concepts.desc: Splits, dividends, buybacks, spinoffs, tender offers and their effect on shareholders.

concepts.label: Reading Company Filings
concepts.desc: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statements, 13F and insider Form 4 filings.

concepts.label: Fundamental Analysis
concepts.desc: Valuing a stock from its business: earnings, ratios, growth, margins and multiples.

concepts.label: Stocks and Share Classes
concepts.desc: Common and preferred stock, share classes, voting rights, dividends and ADRs.

concepts.label: Technical Analysis
concepts.desc: Price and volume patterns, moving averages, momentum and indicators, and their limits.

skills.label: Corporate Action Explainer
skills.desc: Explains a corporate action and its effect on a holder's shares and cost basis.

skills.label: 10-K Reader
skills.desc: Read a 10-K annual filing and extract business, risk factors, MD&A and key financials.

skills.label: Insider and 13F Tracker
skills.desc: Tracks insider Form 4 trades and institutional 13F holdings for a company.

skills.label: Earnings Report Reader
skills.desc: Reads an earnings release and summarizes results versus expectations.

skills.label: Stock Fundamentals Summary
skills.desc: Summarizes a stock's fundamentals: revenue, earnings, margins, valuation multiples and peers.

skills.label: Share Class Explainer
skills.desc: Explains a company's share classes, voting rights and dividend terms.

skills.label: Indicator Calculator
skills.desc: Computes technical indicators for a price series and states what they do and do not show.

mcp.name: Financial Datasets MCP
mcp.desc: Financial Datasets MCP server: company income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, stock prices and market news.

mcp.name: SEC EDGAR MCP
mcp.desc: SEC EDGAR MCP server: company filings, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, XBRL financial data and insider trading forms from EDGAR.

mcp.name: Yahoo Finance MCP
mcp.desc: Yahoo Finance MCP server: stock prices, historical quotes, company financial statements, holders, options chains and news.
